integrity: Special-function formulas proved analytically; finite numerical and simulation tests corroborate but do not replace proof.
scientific_limitations: Exact equilibrium-initialized OU diffusion with full uniform past Poisson relocation; not asserted for other confinement potentials, nonuniform memory, pathwise convergence or a central limit theorem. Publication priority and independent verification remain unestablished.
title: An exact temporal-averaging transition for confined diffusion with uniform-history resetting
